render_rule: On a surviving central face bordering a missing neighbouring face, render that face 0.4 mm outward along the sheet's transverse unit axis. Recession occurs only for the material face itself, based on the existing physical spring-dependent face survival, not cut_length, a hidden prefix or a row label; renderer does not change any node, spring, face survival, gripper, collision or scored constraint. All other sheet visuals remain identical. At 70-degree 1280px and 135 mm working depth, the two receding banks should make a >=5-pixel deep gap. No artificial readout stripe or truth-driven movement command.
screen: Replay the original visual FSM from zero twice with the only new option visual_gap_m. Keep the original structural scorer and closure interlocks. Capture native camera RGB-D, same-exposure scissors and slit, both banks, and the independent structural trajectory. Seal image-only row9_terminal.py predictions before joining structural labels. Require two supported NOT_STOP at actual 8 mm under noise, two consecutive supported STOP_CANDIDATE at actual 9 mm nominal, zero false stops under 9, no tears or overcut. A failed or UNKNOWN pair forbids control integration; no threshold alteration or substitution of scorer labels.
